items.title: The Only Way I Stop Adding Broadcom is an AI Collapse
items.summary: Every time I run the numbers on Broadcom, something keeps pulling me back to add more shares, and one specific scenario is the only thing that could make me stop.

items.title: Broadcom’s AI Growth Story Faces a $161 Billion Anthropic Test
items.summary: Anthropic's leaked IPO prospectus reveals $161.2 billion in Broadcom lease obligations and $518 billion in total infrastructure commitments, raising questions about its ability to pay as it becomes Broadcom's top XPU customer.

items.title: AMP's $5.5B Buyback Aids Shareholder Returns: Will It Be Sustainable?
items.summary: Ameriprise adds $5.5 billion to its share repurchase authorization, backed by strong capital and cash flow.

items.title: The Fed's new chairman has a lot less to say than his predecessor: Chart of the Day
items.summary: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's September speech was much shorter on words. He let the rate hike do the talking.

items.title: He Was Rejected by Goldman Out of College. Now He’s Poised to Run the Bank.
items.summary: John Waldron has said he didn’t do well on the firm’s financial modeling test when he applied for a job decades ago.

items.title: Lazy Customers Are Great for Banks. Could AI Change that?
items.summary: AI agents could move cash to accounts with higher interest rates, potentially threatening banks’ cheap deposits.

items.title: 'Both cannot be right': AI faces a high-stakes paradox
items.summary: Two new analyses question AI labs' optimism that client revenue will eventually outpace the enormous cost of the AI build-out.

items.title: The Fastest Bank Run In U.S. History Saw Customers Pull $42 Billion In A Single Day. Now Apollo’s Chief Economist Warns AI Agents Like Meta’s Muse Could Trigger The Next One.
items.summary: Apollo's chief economist believes AI assistants could drain the cheap deposits that keep banks alive, and one feature already inside Meta's Muse app sits closer to triggering that scenario than most investors realize.
